messages.XP is stored in your save. Changing the: XP is stored in your save. Changing the level fills in the minimum XP for that level. To use thresholds from an installed game, open Settings → Game data.
messages.Set balance replaces the amount in the f: Set balance replaces the amount in the field. Add to balance increases it. Apply balance stages that amount, and Save changes writes it to disk.
messages.TruckCraft uses XP thresholds to calcula: TruckCraft uses XP thresholds to calculate driver levels and presets. Loading a game folder also makes its number-plate badges available. Your saved XP stays as it is.
messages.Using data from the game folder: Using data from the game folder

messages.Select the hazardous cargo classes your: Select the hazardous cargo classes your driver can carry. Apply progression stages skill and cargo-class changes.
messages.Set the selected vehicle’s fuel as a per: Set the selected vehicle’s fuel as a percentage of its tank capacity. Apply fuel stages the change.
messages.Repair stages a reset of damage and repa: Repair stages a reset of damage and repairable wear on the selected vehicle. Include permanent wear also clears age-related wear while preserving mileage.
messages.Choose a rank from 0 to 3 for each coach: Choose a rank from 0 to 3 for each coach skill. Apply coach progression stages the XP and skill changes.
messages.Regenerate replaces the saved offer seed: Regenerate replaces the saved offer seeds. Reset clears them. Company affects the selected depot, while City affects all depots in its city. Save changes writes the result to disk.
Apply offer updates the selected offer. Add as new offer leaves it in place and creates another one. Clear removes every offer at the selected source depot. Save changes writes the edits to disk.
1. Choose ETS2 or ATS on the right.
messages.2. Select a profile and save, then choos: 2. Select a profile and save, then choose Load selected save.
messages.3. Apply your edits and save when you ar: 3. Apply your edits and save when you are ready.
messages.A recovery copy is created when you save: A recovery copy is created when you save. Close the game before editing and keep an independent backup.
messages.Addon choices come from saved parts for: Addon choices come from saved parts for the same vehicle model and slot. Structural parts are shown for reference; their replacement needs a compatible game-data catalog.
messages.An active saved car journey is available: An active saved car journey is available. Fuel, condition and number-plate edits are staged with Undo/Redo.
messages.Automatic profile discovery is off. Open: Automatic profile discovery is off. Open a save file to choose a profile.
messages.Available combinations come from this sa: Available combinations come from this save. Special transports with positioned trailers cannot be cloned. New game-definition catalogs and route-distance calculation are still being migrated.
messages.Buy this garage before assigning occupan: Buy this garage before assigning occupants.
messages.Buy, resize or sell garages. Occupants t: Buy, resize or sell garages. Occupants that no longer fit move to available slots; owned trailers return to headquarters.
messages.Choose a rank. Click the current rank to: Choose a rank. Click the current rank to step down.
messages.Choose a save to start editing: Choose a save to start editing
messages.Choose a section, then add formatting be: Choose a section, then add formatting before it. Controls stay in plate order. Edits are staged with Apply plate.
messages.Choose colours for the existing paint de: Choose colours for the existing paint design. Paint design, materials and other saved settings are retained.
messages.Choose one of this save's recovery snaps: Choose one of this save's recovery snapshots, newest first. Restoration is staged with Undo/Redo. Save changes retains the current files in another recovery copy before writing.
messages.Choose stock game artwork. Existing cust: Choose stock game artwork. Existing custom choices are retained until you select a replacement.
Choose where your next edit begins.
messages.Cities referenced by this save. Visit co: Cities referenced by this save. Visit counts for other cities are retained.
messages.Click a colour swatch to choose a colour: Click a colour swatch to choose a colour. Each saved slot contains four colours.
messages.Close the game before changing profile f: Close the game before changing profile folders.
messages.Close the game before editing. Save crea: Close the game before editing. Save creates a recovery copy, and you should also keep an independent backup.
messages.Copy sharing data below, or paste it and: Copy sharing data below, or paste it and choose Import. Import fills these pickers; Apply stages the edit.
messages.Discard them to continue, or keep editin: Discard them to continue, or keep editing.
messages.Dismissal preserves an active delivery u: Dismissal preserves an active delivery until it finishes. The assigned vehicle stays in your garage.
messages.ETS2 and ATS 1.62.x · Keep a backup befo: ETS2 and ATS 1.62.x · Keep a backup before editing.
messages.ETS2 and ATS names and logos belong to S: ETS2 and ATS names and logos belong to SCS Software. TruckCraft is an independent community project.

messages.Events are written in time order, with t: Events are written in time order, with the newest events at the bottom. Turning logging off retains the existing log.

messages.If Steam Cloud sync is enabled, it may o: If Steam Cloud sync is enabled, it may overwrite edits or cause sync conflicts. Close the game and let sync finish before editing. Editing is still allowed.
messages.Load a save and save or undo pending edi: Load a save and save or undo pending edits before managing its profile folder.
messages.Load game data to choose installed plate: Load game data to choose installed plate badges. Existing badge formatting is always retained.

messages.TruckCraft is a Rust remodel of TS SE To: TruckCraft is a Rust remodel of TS SE Tool. The application uses Apache-2.0. The adapted scs_tools decoder retains its MIT and Apache-2.0 notices.
messages.Staging changes no files. Save changes w: Staging changes no files. Save changes writes settings and save edits together, with changed-file protection and a recovery copy.

messages.The original profile stays in place. Set: The original profile stays in place. Settings and album files are copied; previous tool recovery snapshots are excluded.
